onboarding.step1Title: Did I really turn it off?
onboarding.step1Subtitle: Locked the door? Turned off the stove? Stop going back to check.
onboarding.step2Subtitle: Mark actions with a photo confirmation. It's saved with time and place — you can always look back.
onboarding.step3Subtitle: Lists for Home, Car, Office. Contexts "Leaving" and "Before bed" — so you don't forget a thing.
